notes: RAIToken has no constructor arguments and mints exactly 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units (1,000,000,000 RAI with 18 decimals) once to its deployer. Supply, the 3% buy tax, PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 and tax recipient 0xd85d2a13bd490a21959f1ecabe8ac82221d253bc are constants. Transfers from the PoolManager to other addresses redirect 3% to the tax recipient, rounded down to minor units, and credit the transfer destination with the remainder. Transfers to the PoolManager, including pool seeding and self-transfers, and wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed. No further minting, owner or administrative functions exist. The launch factory performs supply distribution and pool seeding. There are no application contracts. The pool fee is fixed at 1.25%. pool.initialPrice records the RAI-as-currency0 provenance price; the deployer derives the opening price from economics and the deployed currency order.
